# Pharma Solutions International

> > Pharmaceutical distribution platform connecting international pharmaceutical manufacturers with healthcare markets across the GCC and MENA regions, specializing in oncology, critical care, and specialty therapeutics.

Pharma Solutions is a UAE-based pharmaceutical platform serving 14+ countries in the GCC and MENA regions. The company focuses on strategic partnerships with global pharmaceutical manufacturers including Aurobindo, Zydus Healthcare, Boston Biopharma, and Medical Developments International to distribute oncology products, critical care medications, and specialty treatments across the Middle East and North Africa.

## Key Topics

- GCC and MENA pharmaceutical distribution

## Oncology Products

- [Docetaxel 20mg/0.5ml & 80mg/2ml injection Vial](https://www.pharmasolutions-int.com/product/docetaxel-20mg-0-5ml-80mg-2ml-injection-vial): Docetaxel antineoplastic injection by Vianex for cancer treatment

## Critical Care & Specialty Products

- [PENTHROX liquid for inhalation 3ml](https://www.pharmasolutions-int.com/product/penthrox-liquid-for-inhalation-3ml): Penthrox methoxyflurane inhaler for rapid pain relief by MDI Australia
- [VASOSTRICT® Vasopressin 20 units/ml vials](https://www.pharmasolutions-int.com/product/vasostrict-vasopressin-20-units-ml-vials): Vasostrict vasopressin by Par Pharmaceuticals for vasodilatory shock
- [Cosagen (Lacosamide)](https://www.pharmasolutions-int.com/product/cosagen): Cosagen lacosamide for partial-onset seizures and epilepsy treatment
- [Deltyba 50 mg (delamanid tablets)](https://www.pharmasolutions-int.com/product/deltyba-50mg): Deltyba delamanid 50mg tablets for multidrug-resistant tuberculosis

## Anti-Infective Products

- [Tigevitae (TIGECYCLINE)](https://www.pharmasolutions-int.com/product/tigevitae): Tigevitae tigecycline broad-spectrum antibiotic for complex infections
- [Clidacin BA-Free Solution For Injection Ampoule (Clindamycin)](https://www.pharmasolutions-int.com/product/clidacin-ba-free-solution-for-injection-ampoule): Clidacin clindamycin injection by Vianex for bacterial infections
- [Caspovitae (CASPOFUNGIN)](https://www.pharmasolutions-int.com/product/caspovitae-caspofungin): Caspovitae caspofungin systemic antifungal for candidiasis treatment
